channel.description: Recent content in Ai-Engineering on Junho Lee

item.title: Using the ASD-STE100 Aerospace Standard for Clearer LLM Responses
item.description: Andrej Karpathy highlighted ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English as a sharper alternative to ELI5 prompts for stripping ambiguity out of LLM explanations.

item.title: What Remains of Software Engineering When AI Writes Almost All Code
item.description: Assuming AI generates most implementation code, Gergely Orosz examines the design, verification, and operational responsibilities left to engineers and PMs.

item.title: Codenotch: Screen-Edge Widget for Tracking AI Coding Assistant Limits
item.description: Codenotch places a compact screen-edge widget on macOS and Windows to monitor usage quotas, reset timers, and live agent status across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity.

item.title: How Uber Controls AI Coding Costs Across Models, Cache, and Tools
item.description: Uber kept total AI agent spend stable despite a 9.4x jump in weekly requests by breaking down cost drivers and tuning model routing, cache TTLs, and MCP tool loading.

item.title: Automating LLM Prompt Engineering with a Meta-Prompt
item.description: Feed a structured meta-prompt into an LLM like Claude to generate task-specific, low-hallucination prompts from three short user inputs.

item.title: Boil the Sea: Principles of AI-Native Organization Design
item.description: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan outlines how AI-native companies encode operations into Markdown skills and build a curated company memory layer.

item.title: Building a Second Brain with Claude Code and Obsidian
item.description: Connect Claude Code to a local Obsidian vault using CLAUDE.md, four-folder project layouts, and reusable skills to build a portable knowledge base.

item.title: Where AI Moved the Engineering Bottleneck
item.description: As coding agents make implementation cheap, engineering bottlenecks shift to verification, code review, and security, requiring Just-in-Time planning.

item.title: From Prompts to Loops: Expanding AI Engineering Scope and Human Taste
item.description: AI engineering control has expanded from single prompts to context, harnesses, and autonomous loops, making human taste and judgment the deciding factor.

item.title: 8 Practical Ways to Use NotebookLM at Work
item.description: Eight practical workflows turn NotebookLM from a basic summarizer into a private tutor, contradiction detector, and decision-support system.

item.title: Bank of Korea Report: AI Cuts Work Hours Without Lifting Productivity
item.description: A Bank of Korea study finds generative AI trims weekly work hours by 1.5 hours on average, yet output stays flat without workflow redesign and aligned incentives.

item.title: Claude Autoresearch: Autonomous Metric-Driven Iteration in Claude Code
item.description: How Claude Autoresearch runs an 8-step modify-verify-rollback loop inside Claude Code to optimize single metrics like test coverage automatically.

item.title: Building a Cross-Verification Workflow with Claude Code and Codex
item.description: Separating author and reviewer roles across Claude Code and Codex catches blind spots before merge without blocking developer workflows.

item.title: Scrapling: Adaptive Python Web Scraping That Survives UI Redesigns
item.description: Scrapling tracks moved DOM elements automatically when websites change class names, combining anti-bot stealth, proxy rotation, and MCP agent integration.

item.title: 32 Slash-Command Prompt Shortcuts LLMs Understand Out of the Box
item.description: A breakdown of 32 zero-setup slash commands that work immediately in Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini thanks to instruction tuning, plus how to chain them.

item.title: 5. Automating Metadata Maintenance: Karpathy's LLM Wiki Architecture
item.description: RAG starts from scratch every time. Karpathy proposes having the LLM maintain a wiki directly so knowledge accumulates. DataNexus’s ontology catalog needs the same principle to avoid abandonment.

item.title: Automating Consistent HTML Slides with AI Agents and make-slide
item.description: Having an AI agent read a design guideline file before generating HTML slides keeps layout quality remarkably consistent across runs.
